subject: CHANGES REQUESTED S16 @a4ad26b (review): ICS token logged in plain text, SW Trusted Types console error on WebKit, push SW e2e never passes (+6 medium)
body:
Review of S16 at a4ad26b (done msg 20261117T055234-seg16-planner-74ecf8). Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED (3 High, 6 Medium, 5 Low).

WHAT I RAN (local Postgres/Storage/auth containers *-review16 only; hosted DB untouched; see the Space note in D11)
- lint (biome+ruff) PASS; typecheck (tsc+mypy) PASS; vitest 746 PASS; pytest not-live/not-db 1304 PASS; gen:contracts + gen:requirements: no drift.
- alembic: single head 0027; downgrade 0027->0025 and upgrade back clean.
- db (fresh stack): tests/plan + test_rls + test_migrate + test_planner_graph + app_config: 187 pass. Full -m db: 536 pass, 4 F / 17 E, none from S16 (embedder not cached here, no HF access; Storage objects from other segments' tests block the 0002 downgrade in test_migrations round-trip; seed counts tied to that; the known S21 authoring test). Grants checked in information_schema.
- e2e smoke set (planner+today+shell, --retries=0 --workers=2, webkit-ipad-portrait/landscape/phone-390 + chromium-laptop-1440; I installed Chromium 1255 so Chromium ran), 2x: every planner test passed on all 4 projects EXCEPT "push service worker" (Chromium) which failed both runs (D3). The run-1 ICS failure was the environment (D11). The shell/today failures are the S16 Trusted Types line (D2), plus "not enough seeded questions" (my DB isn't seeded).
- Screenshots test-results/screens/16 (iPad portrait/landscape, phone 390, laptop) compared with Planner/PhonePlan boards.
- CI run 44027078060: still QUEUED (whole branch backlog), so the full 3x6 matrix is not judged. Expect Chromium red from D3.

DEFECTS
1. HIGH, ICS feed token logged in plain text. apps/api/naadi_api/middleware.py:87 logs `path`, and Aegra's app.access_logs logs `url`, so every GET /api/plan/ics/{token} (planner_routes.py get_ics) writes the full 43-char token into the Space logs twice. Hashing the token at rest is then pointless: anyone who can read the logs gets working feed URLs. Repro: E2E_SERVER_LOG_DIR=…; run the calendar-feed spec; `grep -oE "/api/plan/ics/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" api-*.log` gives 24 lines, length 43. Fix: redact the token path segment in both loggers (and in client_floor_exceeded), and add a test that the log never contains it.
2. HIGH, SW registration breaks the prod CSP zero-console-errors rule on WebKit. apps/web/src/main.tsx:25 `navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js")` passes a string to a Trusted Types sink under `require-trusted-types-for 'script'`. Result: "[Report Only] This requires a TrustedScriptURL value…" on every prod page load in Safari, which is the primary target. Repro: serve dist with that CSP, load /sign-in in WebKit: 1 error with service workers allowed, 0 with them blocked (Chromium 0); also ~40 shell/today e2e failures on webkit with exactly this line. Once TT is enforced, register() throws and `.catch(() => undefined)` silently turns push off. 942eca1 on tip only filters the line out of the e2e watcher, which hides it rather than fixing it. Fix: a TT policy (createScriptURL that allows only "/sw.js"), and don't swallow the registration error silently.
3. HIGH, the acceptance test for SW push has never passed. apps/web/e2e/planner.spec.ts:440 creates the context without `permissions: ["notifications"]`, so showNotification rejects and `shown` is [] (line 479). Failed 2/2 on chromium-laptop-1440 here, so CI Chromium will fail. Fix: grant notifications for the prod origin, then re-check the click/deep-link half too.
4. MEDIUM, SSRF through push endpoints. planner_models.py:206 accepts any https URL. POST /api/push/test (push/routes.py send_test) and the reminder cron then POST to it from the server with a VAPID JWT: internal hosts, IP literals, metadata addresses. Repro: POST /api/push/subscriptions {endpoint:"https://10.0.0.1/x", keys:{…}}, then POST /api/push/test, and the server makes the call. Fix: allowlist push-service hosts (fcm.googleapis.com, updates.push.services.mozilla.com, *.push.apple.com, *.notify.windows.com) and reject IP literals. Related (low): `on conflict (endpoint) do update set user_id = excluded.user_id` lets any student who learns another's endpoint take it over and break that student's reminders.
5. MEDIUM, clients can write plan_items directly, bypassing the API. 0027_planner.py (end of UPGRADE): `grant update (status, client_updated_at_ms) on plan_items to authenticated`. The brief says "Client may update status only, through the API." Repro: as a signed-in student, PostgREST PATCH /rest/v1/plan_items?id=eq.<own id> {"status":"done","client_updated_at_ms":9999999999999} succeeds (grant confirmed in information_schema). This skips LWW and the API's status Literal. Fix: revoke update and keep select only.
6. MEDIUM, the LWW stamp is not bounded by server time. planner_models.py:139 allows up to 9_999_999_999_999 (year 2286); planner_store.py:290. One write from a device whose clock runs ahead freezes the item: every later honest change returns applied=false. Repro: PATCH with client_updated_at_ms=now+1y, then PATCH with now: applied=false. Fix: clamp to server_now + small skew (or reject).
7. MEDIUM, rebalance spills before dropping reviews, the reverse of the pinned rule. rebalance.py drop loop (`while True: attempt = _Placement…`): drops only happen if something is still unplaced after a placement that already lets read/cards spill. Repro (pure fn): day0 missed read 60m; today (Review day, 1 h target) holds a planned 60m review item; assessment tomorrow; next study day after it. Output: moves m1 past the assessment (spilled=1), drops=[]. The brief says drop the window's Review/Mixed review items first, then spill. Add a property test for this.
8. MEDIUM, the reminder pass re-sends and goes over the cap after a partial failure. push/reminders.py results loop: when payload 1 is ok and payload 2 fails, outcome="failed", so last_sent_on stays unset and every 15-minute pass in the 4 h window re-sends payload 1. That is up to 5 duplicates a day against push_max_per_day=2. Also MAX_FAILURES=5 deletes a device after about 75 min of transient errors; the brief says only 404/410 delete. Fix: record last_sent_on/sent_today when sent_n>0, and don't delete on transient failures (or use a much longer horizon).
9. MEDIUM, accepting a stale proposal can move items into the past. planner_store.py apply() checks only from_day/status, not that to_day >= the student's today or that the target days' loads are unchanged. runs.ts decide() resumes a live thread without recomputing. Repro: Rebalance at 23:30 (moves to today), Accept after midnight: items land on yesterday and are "Behind" at once. Fix: in apply, expire the proposal (stale) if any to_day < local today or a target day's load changed.
10. LOW, the order cursor reports items that do fit as "don't fit before your exam". rebalance.py _Placement.run: once a read item spills to window 1, later question items can't go back to window 0 even when it has room. Repro: missed read 60m then questions 30m; today has 45 min free; assessment tomorrow. Result: q1 "unplaced" (the warning text is false). Report it correctly, or let the cursor reset per window for non-spilling kinds.
11. LOW, the e2e calendar-feed test follows an ambient APP_BASE_URL. playwright.config.ts env() doesn't pin APP_BASE_URL, so feed_url() uses whatever the shell has, and planner.spec.ts:405 fetches it. In this sandbox APP_BASE_URL is the hosted Space, so run 1 sent 4 unauthenticated GETs to arrowassassin-naadi.hf.space/api/plan/ics/<local-only token> (all 404; read-only, nothing written; disclosing it). Fix: APP_BASE_URL: "" in env(), and assert the URL's origin equals baseURL.
12. LOW, planner_routes.py _client_key trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value, which anyone can spoof, so the per-IP ICS limit is bypassable (the per-token limit still holds). Use request.client.host (uvicorn --proxy-headers already resolves it).
13. LOW, UI: at iPad landscape the "Outside Naadi" pill overflows the assessment card and is clipped (src/planner/ItemBlock.tsx; planner-suggestion--webkit-ipad-landscape.png, Sat 14). A non-study day inside the plan (Thu 19) reads "Outside your plan", which is misleading: say it's a day off. Board deviation for the lead to decide: Planner.dc.html has a display-size "Week n of m" hero and road-to-exam milestone cards beside the violet card; the build has a small eyebrow, an H1 "Plan" and a list.
14. LOW, the ICS feed carries free-text item titles from POST /api/plan/items (student/tutor `title`, feed.py build_ics). Whether the feed is free of notes/PII therefore depends on what students type. Consider a generic label for origin='user' items.
NOTE (not counted): at a4ad26b pnpm-lock.yaml had a dangling packages/ui vitest key (no terser variant), so `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` failed. Already repaired on tip by 8dfebd5.

WHAT IS GOOD: pure deterministic rebalance with interrupt-gated apply and zero LLM calls; token hashed, shown once, rotate/revoke gives 404; ICS has stable UIDs, no names/emails, private max-age=900; push payloads are ui_copy key + numbers + deep link, and safeUrl keeps clicks same-origin; one lime CTA (asserted), violet proposal, amber + word + icon for behind; RLS forced with coverage/live_check updated; VAPID private key redacted; ui_copy keys + noHardcodedCopy root.

Re-review needs: D1–D9 fixed with tests, a green CI run including Chromium (push SW test) and webkit with no TT console line.
